document: HomeGuard Privacy Platform — Playwright Executor Specification

design_decisions.browser_management: Pool of N Chromium browser contexts — isolates sessions between brokers, balances memory with throughput, avoids state leakage between runs
design_decisions.error_reporting: Structured error types with auto-screenshot on every failure regardless of playbook screenshot flag — makes retry logic and dashboard display actionable
design_decisions.worker_communication: Async job pattern — worker POSTs task and receives job_id immediately, then polls GET /jobs/{job_id} until complete or timeout
design_decisions.user_agent_pool: Curated built-in list of Chrome/Firefox/Safari UAs per platform, updated with each Docker image build — no runtime external dependency

service_api.description: Internal FastAPI REST API consumed only by Celery worker service over homeguard_net
service_api.auth: None — internal Docker network only, not exposed to LAN

health.description: Docker health check endpoint. Returns pool status.

submit_scan.description: Submit a broker scan job. Returns job_id immediately. Worker polls GET /jobs/{job_id} for result.

request_body.job_id: UUID — generated by caller for idempotency
request_body.profile_id: UUID — for screenshot path and logging
request_body.broker_id: UUID — for screenshot path and logging
request_body.playbook: object — full playbook JSON (active version fetched by worker before calling)
request_body.profile_tokens: object — decrypted PII token map { token_name: value }

submit_optout.description: Submit a web form opt-out job. Same async pattern as scan. Executes the full optout phase of the playbook.

get_job.description: Poll job status and result. Worker calls this every 5 seconds until status is completed or failed.

result.outcome: found | not_found | confirmed | inconclusive | captcha_blocked | rate_limited | error
result.fields_detected: array of field_type strings — scan jobs only
result.dry_run_skipped_steps: array of step ids skipped due to dry_run=true

error.recovery_hint: string — actionable suggestion for retry logic

response_failed.screenshots: array — auto-screenshot always captured on failure

status_codes.404: Job not found or expired (TTL 1 hour)

cancel_job.description: Cancel a queued or running job. Returns the browser context to the pool.

list_jobs.description: List active jobs in the queue. Used by /api/system/health to report queue depth.

response.jobs: array of {job_id, job_type, broker_domain, status, elapsed_ms}

browser_pool.description: Pool of Chromium browser contexts managed by the executor service

pool_size.rationale: 3 contexts fits within 1024MB memory limit while allowing parallel broker scans from multiple Celery workers

context_isolation.model: One BrowserContext per job — each job gets a fresh isolated context with its own cookies, storage, and session state
context_isolation.browser_instance: Single shared Browser object (Chromium) — contexts are lightweight, browsers are heavy
context_isolation.lifecycle: Context created at job start, closed and returned to pool at job end regardless of success or failure

context_config.user_agent: Randomised from built-in pool at context creation — see user_agent_pool section

anti_detection.permissions_spoof: navigator.permissions.query mocked to return denied for notifications
anti_detection.request_delay: Random sleep between PLAYWRIGHT_MIN_DELAY_MS and PLAYWRIGHT_MAX_DELAY_MS between each step
anti_detection.proxy_support: Configured at context level from PLAYWRIGHT_PROXY_URL if set

pool_overflow.behaviour: Return HTTP 503 with { error: pool_exhausted, retry_after_ms: 10000 }
pool_overflow.worker_retry: Celery worker catches 503 and retries the task after 10 seconds

user_agent_pool.description: Built-in curated list of real browser user-agent strings. Updated with each Docker image build. No external dependency at runtime.
user_agent_pool.selection_strategy: Random selection weighted by real-world browser market share (Chrome ~65%, Safari ~20%, Firefox ~15%)

pool_structure.chrome_windows: array of Chrome/Windows UA strings — 20 entries
pool_structure.chrome_mac: array of Chrome/macOS UA strings — 10 entries
pool_structure.chrome_linux: array of Chrome/Linux UA strings — 8 entries
pool_structure.safari_mac: array of Safari/macOS UA strings — 10 entries
pool_structure.safari_ios: array of Safari/iOS UA strings — 8 entries
pool_structure.firefox_windows: array of Firefox/Windows UA strings — 8 entries
pool_structure.firefox_mac: array of Firefox/macOS UA strings — 6 entries

user_agent_pool.update_process: Dockerfile RUN step fetches latest stable browser versions and generates user_agents.json from known version strings
user_agent_pool.override: playbook.user_agent_override bypasses pool selection for a specific broker if set
user_agent_pool.sample_chrome_ua: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/124.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

executor_engine.description: Core playbook execution engine — walks phases and steps, dispatches actions, handles tokens and errors

token_resolution.description: Replaces {token} placeholders in all string values before execution
token_resolution.input: profile_tokens dict from worker — pre-decrypted PII values
token_resolution.method: str.format_map() with custom SafeDict that returns empty string for missing keys and logs a warning
token_resolution.applies_to: url_template, step.value, step.values (all values), step.patterns, step.url_pattern
token_resolution.missing_token_behaviour: Log warning to structured output, replace with empty string, mark step as skipped if step.optional=false

phase_execution.description: Iterates phases array in order. Each phase is executed until completion or on_failure handler fires.
phase_execution.phase_start: If phase.url_template present: navigate to resolved URL before first step

on_failure_handlers.stop: Abort remaining phases, mark job failed, return structured error
on_failure_handlers.skip_phase: Log warning, continue to next phase
on_failure_handlers.mark_manual: Abort remaining phases, set outcome=requires_manual in result, capture screenshot

step_execution.description: Dispatches each step to the appropriate action handler. Each action handler returns StepResult.
step_execution.step_timeout: asyncio.wait_for(timeout=step.timeout_ms) — inherits phase timeout if not set
step_execution.screenshot_capture: Captured after step if step.screenshot=True OR any error occurs
step_execution.dry_run_skip: If playbook.dry_run=True and step.dry_run_skip=True: skip step, log to dry_run_skipped_steps, continue

action_handlers.fill_form: For each (selector, value) in values: await page.locator(selector).fill(value) with 200ms between fields
action_handlers.screenshot: path = build_screenshot_path(profile_id, broker_id, step_id, type); await page.screenshot(path=path, full_page=True)
action_handlers.assert_text: body = await page.inner_text('body'); assert any(p.lower() in body.lower() for p in patterns)
action_handlers.scroll: await page.locator(selector).scroll_into_view_if_needed() if selector else await page.evaluate('window.scrollTo(0, document.body.scrollHeight)')
action_handlers.conditional: count = await page.locator(selector).count(); if count > 0: execute nested steps
action_handlers.submit: if dry_run: skip and log; else: await page.locator(selector).click(); await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')

confirmation_detection.description: Evaluated after every navigate and submit action. Uses match_strategy to determine when confirmation is reached.

implementation.text_check: page_text = await page.inner_text('body'); matched = any(p.lower() in page_text.lower() for p in text_patterns)
implementation.url_check: matched = any(re.search(pattern, page.url) for pattern in url_patterns)
implementation.negative_check: failed = any(p.lower() in page_text.lower() for p in negative_patterns)
implementation.match_any: confirmed = (text_matched OR url_matched) AND NOT negative_matched
implementation.match_all: confirmed = text_matched AND url_matched AND NOT negative_matched

on_confirm: Set confirmation_matched = text_pattern or url_pattern that fired
Stop further phase execution — job complete

captcha_detection.description: Checked after every page navigation. If detected, follows captcha_strategy.
captcha_detection.implementation: After each await page.goto() and await page.wait_for_load_state(): check all captcha_detection.selectors and text_indicators
captcha_detection.detection_method: selector_count = sum(await page.locator(s).count() for s in selectors); text_found = any(t.lower() in page_body for t in text_indicators)

manual: Update broker.captcha_required=True via internal API call to api:8000
2captcha: POST to 2captcha API with site_key and page_url
On API failure: fall back to manual strategy
on_captcha_detected.anticaptcha: Same as 2captcha but using Anti-Captcha API endpoint

error_classification.description: Every Playwright exception and soft error is classified into a structured error type with a recovery hint

timeout.recovery_hint: Increase phase.timeout_ms or step.timeout_ms. Check if broker site is slow.

selector_not_found.recovery_hint: Broker likely changed their page structure. Update playbook selectors.

navigation_failed.recovery_hint: Broker site may be down or URL has changed. Check broker.opt_out_url.

assertion_failed.recovery_hint: Page content or URL does not match expected. Broker may have changed confirmation flow.

captcha_blocked.recovery_hint: CAPTCHA detected. Set captcha_strategy to 2captcha or anticaptcha, or handle manually.

rate_limited.recovery_hint: Increase request_delay_ms in playbook or add proxy rotation.

triggers: submit action completes but no confirmation detected within verify phase
form_submission_failed.recovery_hint: Form submitted but confirmation not detected. Check confirmation.text_patterns and url_patterns.

triggers: Required profile field token not in profile_tokens dict
token_resolution_failed.recovery_hint: Profile is missing required PII field. Add the field in the dashboard.

triggers: JSON Schema validation fails on playbook input
playbook_invalid.recovery_hint: Playbook JSON failed schema validation. Check playbook version in registry.

triggers: No available browser context in pool when job submitted

screenshot_storage.description: All screenshots stored on homeguard_screenshots volume under a structured directory tree

directory_structure.level_2: {broker_id}/ — one directory per broker under each profile

screenshot_types.scan_evidence: Page showing profile data was found on broker site
screenshot_types.form_submission: State of form just before or after submit
screenshot_types.error: Auto-captured on any step failure (type prefixed with auto_error_)
screenshot_types.dry_run: End-of-phase state captures during dry run

screenshot_storage.max_dimensions: Capped at 1920x10000px — full_page=True with scroll capture
screenshot_storage.purge_schedule: purge_at = captured_at + SCREENSHOT_RETENTION_DAYS (set in scanning.screenshots row at capture time)

job_lifecycle.description: Full state machine for a job from submission to result retrieval

state_transitions.action: Job stored in memory, job_id returned
Pool context acquired, executor starts phase iteration
All phases complete or confirmation detected

job_lifecycle.storage: In-memory dict keyed by job_id — no database persistence in playwright service
job_lifecycle.ttl: Jobs retained in memory for 1 hour after completion, then evicted. Worker must poll within 1 hour.
job_lifecycle.polling_interval_recommendation: Worker polls every 5 seconds. Job estimated_duration_ms returned on submit for smart initial delay.

service_startup.description: Sequence of operations when the playwright container starts
steps: 2. Launch Chromium browser via playwright.chromium.launch(headless=True, args=[...anti-detect flags])
3. Pre-warm browser pool — create PLAYWRIGHT_POOL_SIZE BrowserContext objects
4. Load and validate all playbook files from /app/playbooks/ against JSON Schema
6. Write startup log: { service: playwright, pool_size: N, chromium_version: X, playbooks_loaded: N }
service_startup.graceful_shutdown: On SIGTERM: complete running jobs, reject new jobs, close all contexts, close browser

internal_api_calls.description: Playwright service makes internal calls to the main API service for certain operations
internal_api_calls.auth_mechanism: INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN — a shared secret injected via .env, used only for inter-service calls on homeguard_net
internal_api_calls.note: All other state updates (scan_results, screenshots DB rows) are written by the Celery worker after receiving the job result — playwright service does not write to the database directly

playwright/.main.py: FastAPI app — route definitions, lifespan handler (startup/shutdown)
playwright/.executor.py: PlaybookExecutor class — phase/step iteration, action dispatch
playwright/.actions.py: Individual action handler functions (navigate, fill, click, etc.)
playwright/.confirmation.py: Confirmation detection and captcha detection logic
playwright/.screenshot.py: Screenshot path builder and capture helper
playwright/.user_agents.json: Curated built-in UA pool — updated per image build
playwright/.models.py: Pydantic models — ScanJobRequest, OptoutJobRequest, JobResult, StepResult, ErrorResult
playwright/.requirements.txt: playwright, fastapi, uvicorn, pydantic, aiofiles, jsonschema

worker_integration.description: How the Celery worker (scan_broker, submit_web_form_optout tasks) interacts with the playwright service
scan_flow: 1. Worker fetches active playbook from DB
2. Worker decrypts profile fields and builds profile_tokens dict
4. Worker POST /jobs/scan — receives {job_id, status: queued, estimated_duration_ms}
5. Worker sleeps estimated_duration_ms * 0.8 (head start before first poll)
7. On status=completed: worker writes scan_result to DB, creates exposure if found, dispatches SSE event
8. On status=failed: worker logs error, increments retry count, re-raises for Celery retry
9. On poll timeout (job_ttl exceeded): worker treats as error, marks result=error
worker_integration.poll_timeout: Worker stops polling after max(estimated_duration_ms * 3, 120000) ms — treats as executor crash
worker_integration.idempotency: job_id generated by worker is stable — same task retry reuses same job_id, executor deduplicates
worker_integration.concurrent_calls: Up to PLAYWRIGHT_POOL_SIZE workers can call playwright simultaneously. 503 handled by Celery retry.
